en-IN.name: Exam Buddy
en-IN.summary: Multiple choice practice quizzes for I C S E class 9 and 10 maths and science.
en-IN.description: Exam Buddy quizzes you on the I C S E class 9 and 10 syllabus in maths, physics, chemistry and biology. Pick a class and subject, and optionally a chapter. Alexa reads five multiple choice questions, you answer with A, B, C or D, and after each answer you hear whether you were right and a short explanation. You get your score at the end of every round.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask exam buddy to quiz me on class ten physics
Alexa, ask exam buddy for class nine maths trigonometry

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'open exam buddy', then a class and subject such as 'class 10 physics' or 'class 9 maths trigonometry'. Answer each question with A, B, C or D. Say 'repeat', 'skip', 'help' or 'what chapters are there in class 10 chemistry' at any time.
